  "name_a": "Open fields and sparse vegetation",
  "name_b": "Dense woodland and tree cover",
  "definition": "A patch lies closer to A when broad, smooth areas of cropland, bare ground or sparse vegetation dominate, with relatively little tree canopy. It lies closer to B when dense, textured tree cover dominates, with open ground mostly confined to clearings or narrow strips.",
  "cues": [
    "Dominant cover: extensive open surfaces in A versus largely continuous tree canopy in B.",
    "Texture: smooth field interiors in A versus finely mottled or grainy canopy, sometimes arranged in rows, in B.",
    "Color: A mixes pale tan ground and green or bright-red fields; B is predominantly dark green in true color and deeper red in false color.",
    "Layout: A has broad exposed parcels with isolated trees or thin tree lines; B has clearings embedded within wooded blocks."
  ],
  "visible": "high"
}
